Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (2 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.107), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9965. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.107); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.544.
